prompt:
Image format: a vertical portrait-orientation photograph, 4:5 aspect ratio, taller than it is wide.

A full-body photograph in the Court of the Lions at the Alhambra with a pale marble floor, slender arcade columns, standard-height arched doorways and a low fountain, empty of visitors, bright and evenly lit, shadows soft, the whole floor and surroundings clearly visible and in focus, empty of any people other than the subjects, no readable signs or text anywhere, no props or statues made of the same material as them, NO dark background NO black void, TWO people standing side by side with generous spacing so every figure reads clearly and nobody's arms cross a neighbour, the camera set back so both are visible from head to toe, shot on a medium format camera with an 85mm lens at f/8, in natural sunlight, sharp focus on every figure, realistic photographic grain — a real photograph, not an illustration, not CGI, not a render.

LEFT: ONE real adult Spanish woman, her face exactly the same tone as her body, real skin texture with visible pores and fine grain, dramatic winged liner, a deep red lip, a passionate expression, warm olive skin, cool ash-grey hair styled in sleek straight, real living eyes, wearing a different earring on each ear: on one ear a single long rose-gold chain ending in one large faceted sapphire drop, and on the other ear a large platinum hoop carrying four heavy rough hammered matte metal weights on platinum chains of different lengths (a tin ship's anchor, a silver cube-shaped block, a silver chunky hexagonal nut-shaped weight with a round hole through the centre, a gold square-sided cowbell), all hanging clear of the body and none below the collarbone, and a single gold bracelet. Extremely long stiletto nails, glitter finish studded with crystals.
LEFT Physique: an extraordinarily curvaceous woman, far beyond any real person; a colossal heavy bust projecting far forward and wider than her shoulders is the first thing the eye lands on, and directly below it her waist pulls in to an impossibly narrow, sharply defined line with a deep shadowed groove, then full round hips and soft thick thighs flare out beneath as a strong second curve; the drop from bust to waist is the most dramatic part of her silhouette; not thin, not boyish, not a straight figure; her head looks small above her bust; her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other Her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other.
LEFT Body Art: Her body carries snake scales (diamond-shaped angular scales aligned in neat overlapping rows), BLAZING DEEP EMERALD scale formations, VIVID JADE scale-edge detail, every scale catching its own glint and casting its own small shadow. It is fused to her own living skin and flexes slightly over every bulge, with no fabric, seam or garment anywhere. It covers her whole body with no bare skin left anywhere below the jaw: shoulders, upper arms, forearms, backs of her hands, sides, back, rear, lower belly, knees, calves and the tops of her feet. Her face is left bare and the material fades out at the neck with no hard line.
LEFT Pose: square to camera, feet wide, arms clear of her body.
LEFT Footwear: Extreme gold ballet heels with a razor-thin tapered heel a full forty inches tall and a twelve-inch hidden front platform.

RIGHT: ONE real adult Hawaiian man in his early 30s, his face exactly the same tone as his body, real skin texture with visible pores and fine grain, a pretty androgynous idol face with large doe eyes, a small chin and a soft jaw, clean-shaven, deep plum smoky eyes with dark lashes, smooth warm bronze skin, a shy sweet smile, sleek silver-grey hair styled in a crown braid wrapping around the head, real living eyes, wearing a different earring on each ear: on one ear a large bronze hoop carrying five heavy rough hammered matte metal weights on bronze chains of different lengths (a silver hammer head, a bronze small flared temple bell, a lead chunky hexagonal nut-shaped weight with a round hole through the centre, a silver barrel-shaped weight, a silver miniature anvil), all hanging clear of the body and none below the collarbone, and on the other ear a large platinum hoop carrying three heavy rough hammered matte metal weights on platinum chains of different lengths (an iron ship's anchor, a silver barrel-shaped weight, a silver pyramid-shaped lump), all hanging clear of the body and none below the collarbone, and a single mixed-metal bracelet. Extremely long stiletto nails, glitter finish studded with crystals.
RIGHT Physique: An extraordinarily large, thick, heavy and extremely strong man, far beyond any real person, built like a powerlifter. A huge barrel chest, enormously wide shoulders and back, a thick solid waist with a firm rounded belly over strong abs, massive arms, and enormous thick thighs and calves. Every part is large, dense and continuous rather than sharply cut. His arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other.
RIGHT Body Art: His body carries koi scales (rounded smooth scales with fine visible growth rings, each scale glossy and slightly domed), BLAZING ELECTRIC CRIMSON scale formations, VIVID PEARL WHITE scale-edge detail, every scale catching its own glint and casting its own small shadow. It is fused to his own living skin and flexes slightly over every bulge, with no fabric, seam or garment anywhere. It covers his whole body with no bare skin left anywhere below the jaw: shoulders, upper arms, forearms, backs of his hands, sides, back, rear, lower belly, knees, calves and the tops of his feet. His face is left bare and the material fades out at the neck with no hard line.
RIGHT Pose: square to camera, feet wide, arms clear of his body.
RIGHT Footwear: Extreme tan-brown chunky platform boots with thick platform soles rising far higher than his ankle bone, at least three times the thickness of an ordinary sole.

Skin (everyone): Real photographic skin — visible pores and fine grain, a taut surface with natural creases and shadow only where the flesh and muscle fold. No smooth illustration finish, no plastic CG sheen.

Background & Lighting: each material catching the sunlight in sharp glints, the sunlight carving every fold, curve and muscle. Vertical 4:5 portrait-orientation full-body photograph, taller than it is wide, all faces toward the camera.
